source.downloadAccess: Public, subject to acceptance of the displayed dataset terms

review.role: Secondary geometry reconstruction only; never the authority for the vote values displayed by CivicResultMaps.
review.joinRule: Each of the 1,661 geometry features must match exactly one official result row by county and complete presidential vote signature before vote fields are removed.
review.caveat: VEST combines statewide and county election-authority source material. The retained reviewed crosswalk, exact hash, and official-result reconciliation are required for use.
